The project lifecycle

Good work begins with a clear sequence.

A disciplined process helps align requirements, site realities, approvals and execution before they become avoidable problems.

01

Consultation

We begin with the requirement, intended use and the decisions that will define the project.

02

Site assessment

Existing conditions, dimensions and practical constraints are understood before work is shaped around them.

03

Concept & design

Spatial, material and technical directions are brought into a coherent proposal.

04

Estimation

Scope is reviewed to establish an informed basis for the next step.

05

Approval

Key decisions are aligned before execution begins.

06

Execution

Coordinated site work carries the approved scope into the built environment.

07

Quality control

Work is checked against the details and standards agreed for the project.

08

Handover

The completed work is reviewed and prepared for its next chapter of use.
